'''Tokare Garrison''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Named in honor of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vandar Tokare]], who served on the [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council]], the base served as a resupply point for Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating in the territory of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the Republic's [[Third Galactic War|third war]] with them.<ref name="Tokare Garrison" />

The base was used by Republic forces as center of operations against the Imperial soldiers and [[Nova Blades]] during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].<ref name="Marauders">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=event|The Marauders of Dantooine}}</ref>
